_README: Copy this file to `credentials.e2e.json` (same folder) and fill in real values.
`credentials.e2e.json` is gitignored — never commit real credentials.
apiBaseUrl:  The deployed `api` function URL, WITHOUT a trailing slash.
webApiKey:   Firebase Web API key (Project settings → General → Web API Key).
This is a public client key; it's only used to sign the test
accounts in via the Identity Toolkit REST API.
accounts:    THREE dedicated test accounts that already exist in Firebase Auth
(email/password). The `owner` account MUST own zero progresses at
the start of a run — the tests create/delete their own and rely on
a clean baseline for the 'max 2 progresses' assertions.
Run: npm run test:e2e   (hits the REAL backend — no emulator).
